problem_text:
A media operator is planning a campaign window involving 23 clients. Each client proposes a shortlist of commercial packages; across all clients there are 434 candidate packages in total. For any given client, at most one package can be signed. A signed package serves as a "key" that enables a catalog of executable opportunities associated with that package.

Across the window there are 6255 opportunities. When an opportunity is activated, it delivers a known profit of profit value per opportunity (see data/options.csv). However, each opportunity also requires a specific combination of scarce inventory units (for example, particular time slots, placements, or audience-quota units). There are 99 inventory units in total, and each unit can be allocated to at most one activated opportunity during the window.

The operator must choose which packages to sign (possibly none for some clients) and which opportunities to activate, so that inventory is never double-booked and the campaign profit is as large as possible.
